rubric_items.reason: All 19 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-19) are traced by at least one story. There are no assumed REQs.
Each story has one user-facing outcome. S-1 combines listing, the time-zone rule, Inactive exclusion and the empty state, but all of them serve one outcome.

Prior F-1 is fixed: S-1 AC5 (two blocks, one row, booked 1 / free 3 / next 09:30) is correct and catches a per-block join. The time-zone and now-boundary ACs discriminate. S-7 AC2/AC3 still compare to an undefined baseline.
Values are illustrative test data or come from the intent. UTC+05:30 and 22:30 UTC are derived inline from Asia/Kolkata (REQ-3), and 28 Nov 2026 is a Saturday.
Terms are clear and consistent. The body restates the ACs in a shorter form that drops When clauses (for example S-1 AC5), so it could drift from the front matter.

findings.text: Not fixed from attempts 1 and 2: S-7 AC2 and AC3 still compare to 'the same values as before this change' and name no expected values. The check depends on a pre-change baseline that the AC does not define.
